title: the sum line and the twin line (the Fibonacci line runs by addition alone under the 84 line end — fifty-five in ten steps, the eighty-nine off-line — its twin under the same rule reaches seventy-six in nine, and the two welding identities (the doubled term is the term times the twin; the square sum of two consecutive terms is the term at the doubled-plus-one index) hold at every on-line index; COURSE B band 1 of 2)

lesson.statement: the sum line runs by addition alone: start at zero and one, and every later term is the sum of the two before it — on my line the line reaches fifty-five in ten steps, and the eleventh step, the eighty-nine, stands off-line as my line already declared it; the twin line starts at two and one under the same rule and reaches seventy-six in nine steps; each term is derived from the two before it, not asserted from outside; at the line end eighty-four

the twin line welds to the sum line in two ways: the doubled term is the term times the twin (the doubling reads the twin as its multiplier), and the square sum of two consecutive terms is the term at the doubled-plus-one index — two roads, one destination, verified on my line at every on-line index; at the line end eighty-four

theorems.statement: the twin line of my store is filed of record: the sum line runs by addition alone to the fifty-five and the twin under the same rule to the seventy-six, the identities weld the two lines at every on-line index, and the eighty-nine stands once more as the ceiling the line already declared; filed on the line, at the line end eighty-four
